## Endpoints

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /api/alerts/banner/published_website_entity_for_page` — Get banner alerts for a specific page.
- `GET /api/alerts/v2/overlay/published_website_entity_for_page` — Get overlay alerts for a specific page.
- `GET /api/v4/capture_modals` — Retrieve capture modal configurations.
- `GET /static-scripts/v2/{v2Date}/locales/en/{enId}` — Retrieve locale-specific static script.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /com.snowplowanalytics.snowplow/tp2` — Send tracking data to Snowplow.
